author: Yffe
content: FIX PLAN (acto-fixer, blocker #120): single-file fix in thermite-spec/src/validator.rs, fn check_match_exhaustiveness. ROOT CAUSE: the matched enum is inferred only from an arm naming a declared variant (variant_pattern_name); a guarded-only/catch-all-only match names none, so matched_enum is None and the fn returns Ok(()) with no check. FIX: in the matched_enum-None branch, when the match has arms AND every arm is guarded (arm.guard.is_some()), no arm completes the match unconditionally -> push SpecError::NonExhaustiveMatch. The scrutinee-type approach is unavailable (untyped AST, OQ-3); the all-arms-guarded fallback is the sound reject the design (11-ergonomics REQ-3/AC-3b) sanctions. DISTINCTION preserved: unguarded _ catch-all stays accepted (exhaustive); slice/Option/integer matches with unguarded arms stay inert. Un-ignore the pin after green gauntlet.
